newsitem.title: USA: Columbus McKinnon extends Spreckels offer.
newsitem.headline: Columbus McKinnon extends Spreckels offer.

text.p: Columbus McKinnon Corp said on Wednesday that it would extend its $24 per share cash tender offer for Spreckels Industries Inc, which is doing business as Yale Industries, until October 16.
The tender offer for the acquisition began on August 30 and had been set to expire at midnight EDT on October 9.

As of the close of business on October 18, Columbus said, 1.5 million Spreckels Class A common shares, 126,262 $1 warrants, 323,825 $15 warrants, and 103,047 $11.67 warrants to purchase shares of Class A common stock had been tendered.
Columbus McKinnon designs, manufactures and sells material handling, lifting and positioning products.
